note: Three things. A file that types a temperature but no pressure was flown at sea-level pressure at its own pad - true of most imported RASAero files, worth 29.7 percent of apogee on one design - so the field is now labelled station pressure, says what blank does, and the importer flags a file that names none at a high site. A RASAero stage's stated launch weight could count its motor twice once that motor was loaded (156 lb against a file's own 87 on MESOS); the app now takes the motor's weight and CG back out on every route it can arrive by. And AeroTech's own nozzle dimensions are on file for 191 motors, read from the manufacturer's drawings - not wired into the app yet, but it already shows a tester's file giving the N1000W an exit two and a half times too large in area.
